cap: Read each condition across four facts. A uterus means no AMH was made; no uterus means a testis made it. A 46,XY girl with streak gonads and a uterus has Swyer syndrome and a gonadoblastoma risk; breasts with sparse pubic hair and no uterus mean androgen insensitivity, whereas normal hair means Müllerian agenesis. A virilized 46,XX infant has ovaries and a uterus in CAH, and maternal virilization points to placental aromatase deficiency.
teach: Testosterone, DHT and AMH each have a separate target: AMH removes the uterus, testosterone keeps the Wolffian ducts, and DHT builds the external genitalia. Androgen insensitivity breaks the receptor that both androgens use. A 46,XX person with testes carries SRY on an X chromosome after crossing over in paternal meiosis, so the testes make AMH and testosterone but the missing Y genes leave him azoospermic.
